summary.zh: 用 STRIDE 做威胁建模并查找泄露密钥
summary.en: STRIDE threat models, DREAD scores and secret scans

description.zh: 对设计和代码做安全评估：用 STRIDE 列出可被攻击的环节，用 DREAD 给风险排序，并扫描代码库中泄露的密钥。适合评审新功能风险、判断可能被怎么攻击或上线前自查时使用。
description.en: Assesses designs and code for security: STRIDE threat modeling, DREAD risk scoring and scanning the repository for leaked secrets. Use it to size up a new feature or run a pre-launch check.
